name: Nintendo Switch Lite
significance: Completed Nintendo's total historical consolidation of portable and home software libraries into a singular hardware ecosystem.

editorialContent.overview: A pure handheld-dedicated iteration of the Switch hardware, trading TV docking for enhanced portability, battery efficiency, and a traditional D-pad.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Completed Nintendo's total historical consolidation of portable and home software libraries into a singular hardware ecosystem.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Integrated non-detachable controls with classic directional +D-pad
